4.en: This fabric can withstand heat from the dryer.
4.zh: 这种布料能经受烘干机的高温。

5.en: You can withdraw cash from the machine outside the bank.
5.zh: 你可以在银行外的机器上取现金。

10.en: Her actions are consistent with what she says.
10.zh: 她的行为和她说的话一致。

12.en: The app gives an almost instantaneous reply.
12.zh: 这款应用几乎能即时回复。

15.en: Local residents constitute half of the volunteers.
15.zh: 当地居民占志愿者总数的一半。

17.en: You can substitute oat milk for dairy milk in this recipe.
17.zh: 这个食谱里可以用燕麦奶代替牛奶。

20.en: A public library is an important community institution.
20.zh: 公共图书馆是重要的社区机构。

33.en: The judge tried to put aside her personal prejudice.
33.zh: 法官努力搁置个人偏见。

34.en: The test may contain bias against students who speak another language at home.
34.zh: 这项测试可能对在家说其他语言的学生有偏见。

36.en: The news site is independent of the government.
36.zh: 这个新闻网站独立于政府。

40.en: Please explain the gravity of the problem to the team.
40.zh: 请向团队说明问题的严重性。

42.en: A short walk can relieve stress after a long day.
42.zh: 忙碌一天后，短暂散步可以缓解压力。

54.en: The city plans to exploit wind power to produce clean energy.
54.zh: 这座城市计划利用风能生产清洁能源。
